models.cross_validation: Leave-one-scene-out, both tasks and all trajectories in a scene kept together. Test-trajectory prior is reset, updated only from its own previous observed attempts.
models.freeze: Fit all six predeclared candidates on all calibration data, freeze parameters. No reserved-validation calls in this campaign.
models.selection: Select success family/scale by equal-scene success Brier and write family separately by conditional write Brier. Paired-scene one-SE rule from each minimum; prefer constant,error_lifetime,information_order in order and scale0 before1.5. Joint Brier describes assembled kernel, not a reason to worsen success prediction.
models.training: Only this new cohort; all actual attempts. Same task retains its latent offset across all trajectories and trials. Distinct state-specific seeds2110..2116 avoid deliberate common-random-number dependence between trajectories.
models.write_scope: Failure-conditional E/C/B/U/A; no task offset in write model

precision.bootstrap: 20000 scene-cluster replicates, seed2026102502; all seven states and attempts remain nested
precision.interpretation: Pilot SD describes three-seed task averages, not this one-seed-per-state design. The displayed normal widths are optimistic sensitivity references; calibration is not a powered confirmatory15pp recovery-effect study. Prediction-score variance and formal validation size will be estimated from held-scene scores before validation calls.
precision.primary_unit: Scene (18); two tasks nested per scene, one seed per task/state

question: Can a small common memory kernel, with a persistent task-success mixture, describe first and naturally reached second attempts without operation-specific fits?
scope: New-task calibration of shared success and natural reflection-write kernels

semantics.A: Target precondition cannot be assigned reliably, including unresolved referents/implicit ordering
semantics.B: Both target wrong and correct preconditions are explicitly present
semantics.C: Explicit correct inventory precondition, no target wrong precondition
semantics.E: Explicit target wrong precondition, no correct alternative
semantics.U: Neither target precondition is stated; other advice may remain
semantics.review: New full-text Codex annotation by content hash, no human second review; B is not a synonym for A; no reused old A relabelling

support: Constructed initial states plus native states reached after one failure. No claim for empty memory, native initial paragraphs, longer budgets or unseen error types.
